items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: I never seen his band, I seen another one, Robichaud's band.

ctx.x: Oh yes. I never knew him, I've heard of him.

Well he used to play with my brother. Well, he was a good guitar player, manly player, banjo player. He was a string hand, for instance, man. Well, he turned around and I see him and I say, Willie, I says, I says, how about, what is that you're making this now? So, I just have to buy him a little drink or something like that, you know, and I know he used to like his beer and his wine and all that. Well, I, you know, I was working, I had to work, because I never had no music on me, I never had nothing to learn, I…
I know. Manuel Mineta teaches all of those same kind of things. Manuel Mineta? He teaches time like that, too, and all that.
